recommended_primary: End-stage renal disease (ESRD) secondary to diabetic nephropathy, on chronic dialysis
review_summary: The junior differential captures the major disease processes, especially ESRD, CAD, and bleeding risk. Several risk diagnoses were given modest probabilities; after review they merit higher likelihoods, while the infection entry is likely over‑estimated. The main limitation is missing key laboratory data that prevent confirmation of many risk items. Overall reasoning quality is good but would improve with complete labs and refined probability weighting.
